documents.title: Vermont Record of Divorce or Annulment
search_queries: Vermont record of divorce or annulment
mapping_evidence: Vermont Judiciary lists the Department of Health Record of Divorce or Annulment (VDH-VR-DIV) among the forms to complete and file to start a divorce. Vermont Department of Health states the initiating party completes the record, files it with the court as part of the divorce proceeding, and the court clerk sends it to the Health Department after the decree becomes final. The form is therefore a court filing even though the clerk later forwards it to Vital Records.
